frozen_before: any implementation, any training step, any EVAL access
THE_QUESTION: Can exact selective strategic supervision during training preserve complementary latent roles, even though the policy itself cannot predict online which states are resolvable?
why_this_replaces_the_online_route: Online state-level resolvability is NOT CONFIRMED and both routes to it are closed: per-cell thresholds bottom out at o*_min = 0.3455 against a 0.10 ceiling even with oracle labels, and a zero-parameter cell lookup (global AUC 0.7194) beats both the frozen Q_psi head (0.7109) and a dedicated encoder (0.6780). But the 160-seed collection already contains EXACT deterministic labels for the FIT states, so the policy never needs to predict resolvability -- it only needs to be supervised where the payoff evidence establishes a preference.

SIGN_CONVENTION_CORRECTION.issue: The PI ruling as written stated 'Delta > 0 => A-preferred, Delta < 0 => B-preferred'. That is inverted relative to the convention frozen everywhere else.
SIGN_CONVENTION_CORRECTION.the_frozen_convention: Delta(s) = M(pi_B|s) - M(pi_A|s), so Delta > 0 means pi_B achieved the HIGHER margin => B-preferred.
SIGN_CONVENTION_CORRECTION.it_is_arithmetic_not_choice: Given the definition of Delta, the mapping is forced.
consistent_across: fit_k2_preference_probe.py load_split (label 1 = B preferred when d > 0)
SIGN_CONVENTION_CORRECTION.what_implementing_the_stated_signs_would: Anchored z_0 toward pi_A precisely on states where pi_B is measurably better, and z_1 toward pi_B where pi_A is better. The experiment would have tested the exact inverse of the intended treatment while still producing some latent differentiation -- so it would not have failed visibly, it would have silently answered the opposite question.
SIGN_CONVENTION_CORRECTION.resolution: The PI's substantive intent (A-preferred anchors z_0 toward pi_A) is frozen with the correct sign mapping.

label_rule_frozen.quantity: Delta(s) = M(pi_B|s) - M(pi_A|s), deterministic terminal win margin
label_rule_frozen.A_preferred: Delta < 0  ->  anchor z_0 toward pi_A; leave z_1 UNTOUCHED
label_rule_frozen.B_preferred: Delta > 0  ->  anchor z_1 toward pi_B; leave z_0 UNTOUCHED
label_rule_frozen.preference_not_established: Delta == 0  ->  ZERO strategic pressure on either latent

TREATMENT.why_leave_the_other_latent_untouched: Explicitly pushing the non-preferred latent away would manufacture divergence. The experiment asks whether selective supervision PRESERVES complementary roles, not whether we can force them apart.
TREATMENT.ties_never_say_become_A_or_become_B: The core principle of the whole abstention arc survives intact: a tied state exerts no A/B pressure whatsoever.
TREATMENT.base_architecture: EXP2C-style shared K=2 with private heads -- the best-understood pieces already debugged
held_fixed: SAPPO pi_A and pi_B teachers frozen, sha-pinned
TREATMENT.the_single_new_delta: teacher rehearsal is selectively gated by the exact FIT branch labels

REHEARSAL_BANK.balance: 52.6% / 47.4% of resolvable -- neither latent is starved
REHEARSAL_BANK.independent_confirmation_of_complementar: Each teacher is preferred on its own pole -- pi_A 181 to 86 on pole A, pi_B 117 to 44 on pole B. This reproduces EXP1's complementarity from data collected for an entirely different purpose, and it means the gate tracks real specialisation rather than an arbitrary partition.

NO_MARGIN_FILTER.ruling: All 428 resolvable states are used. No |Delta| >= 2 filter, no margin weighting.
NO_MARGIN_FILTER.why: Under the frozen target, deterministic Delta != 0 MEANS a preference is established. A one-point margin is thin but not noisy under a deterministic branch procedure. Filtering would invent a scientific rule the label definition never had.
NO_MARGIN_FILTER.and_it_would_worsen_the_main_threat: 428 -> 101 states is a 4x smaller bank and therefore far heavier repeated exposure over a 1M-step run. That trades thin-but-legitimate signal for stronger-looking signal at dramatically higher memorisation risk.
NO_MARGIN_FILTER.disclosed_limitation: 327 of 428 resolvable states (76.4%) have |Delta| = 1. That is a limitation of the terminal-margin target, recorded rather than hidden by pruning.
NO_MARGIN_FILTER.permitted_later: |Delta| >= 2 may serve as a SECONDARY sensitivity analysis if the primary experiment works. It may never replace the primary treatment.

REHEARSAL_MECHANICS_FROZEN.cadence_and_strength: unchanged from the existing validated SAPPO-style rehearsal
PROHIBITED: changing sampling in response to training performance
REHEARSAL_MECHANICS_FROZEN.why_so_conservative: to keep the experiment focused on the ONE new delta: exact payoff-gated supervision.

PRIMARY_VALIDITY_THREAT.threat: 428 fixed states replayed across a 1M-step run may be MEMORISED rather than generalised from.
PRIMARY_VALIDITY_THREAT.it_displaces_the_earlier_concern: Latent starvation is NOT the risk -- FIT is 52.6/47.4 balanced.
PRIMARY_VALIDITY_THREAT.detection: held-out EVAL is the only instrument that distinguishes memorisation from generalisation
PRIMARY_VALIDITY_THREAT.required_reporting: per-state and per-latent exposure counts, so replay intensity is a measured quantity rather than an assumption

GATES.the_real_gold_standard: Strategic payoff and crossover -- whether the complementary roles actually survived -- judged with the frozen confidence machinery. No threshold in this spec decides that.

AMENDMENT_1_PERSISTENT_Z_TO_POLE_ROLLOUT.record: AMENDMENT 1 -- restore persistent latent-to-pole assignment in the ROLLOUT.
AMENDMENT_1_PERSISTENT_Z_TO_POLE_ROLLOUT.frozen_before: any rollout implementation, any PPO step

THE_RULING.z0: permanently assigned to Pole A rollout environments
THE_RULING.z1: permanently assigned to Pole B rollout environments

AMENDMENT_1_PERSISTENT_Z_TO_POLE_ROLLOUT.FIXED_OPPONENT_DOES_NOT_MEAN_ONE_GLOBAL_: It means each environment gets one fixed opponent assignment that never changes. 16 environments permanently on the Pole-A opponent for z0, 16 permanently on the Pole-B opponent for z1.
AMENDMENT_1_PERSISTENT_Z_TO_POLE_ROLLOUT.WHY: Without it the two halves of the treatment fight different scientific stories. The rehearsal bank says 'reinforce z0 toward pi_A where A is measurably better'. If ordinary PPO gives both latents an identical rollout distribution, the main objective continually pushes both latents toward the same general solution while the rehearsal loss tries to hold them apart. Persistent pole assignment makes the on-policy experience and the selective rehearsal point in compatible directions.
AMENDMENT_1_PERSISTENT_Z_TO_POLE_ROLLOUT.AND_IT_BLUNTS_THE_MEMORISATION_THREAT: With a shared rollout opponent, any eventual differentiation would come almost entirely from replaying 428 fixed states -- making the primary validity threat worse and muddying the causal question. Persistent pole assignment gives the rehearsal signal real on-policy ecological support.

THE_DISTINCTION_THAT_MUST_NOT_BE_CONFLAT.why_it_matters: A pole-B state can be A-preferred -- 44 such states exist in FIT. Rollout assignment is by pole; rehearsal anchoring is by which teacher the payoff evidence actually favours. Conflating them would anchor z1 toward pi_A on those states and destroy the specialisation the experiment is testing.

POLE_IS_NOT_JUST_AN_OPPONENT_TAG.finding: Pole A is OP6 PLUS a frozen genome overlay (SDS2_A_payoff_INIT_3, overlay {'min_alive_for_defender': 2} -- a CONDITIONAL defender). Pole B is OP7 with NO overlay. POLES = {'A': 'OP6', 'B': 'OP7'}.
POLE_IS_NOT_JUST_AN_OPPONENT_TAG.why_this_nearly_broke_the_ruling: Assigning z0's environments to plain OP6 would have put them against a DIFFERENT opponent than the pole-A states in the rehearsal bank were collected against. The ecological support would have been against the wrong adversary, silently undermining the entire rationale for this amendment.
POLE_IS_NOT_JUST_AN_OPPONENT_TAG.resolution: install_keyed_opponent_overlays(core, {'OP6': pole_A_genome()}) keys the overlay by LIVE OPPONENT TAG, not env index. Environments running OP6 receive it, environments running OP7 do not, and its docstring states it stays synchronized with the per-environment opponent sampler ACROSS AUTO-RESETS without a stale per-env list -- the exact EXP2B failure mode, already designed against.
POLE_IS_NOT_JUST_AN_OPPONENT_TAG.required: The overlay MUST be installed. Plain OP6 is not Pole A.

per-reset (z, live opponent) pairs are the observable, not config intent
